sentences.en: Let me donate what little money I have with me.
sentences.zh: 让我捐点我身上的钱吧。

sentences.en: What marvelous work he's doing, donating books to needy children!
sentences.zh: 他为贫困儿童捐赠书籍真是太棒了！

sentences.en: Too bad! Too few rich people donate to the orphanage.
sentences.zh: 真可惜！太少了富人捐给孤儿院的钱。
